name: Save a valid initial profile
path: Form → valid → Finish setup → save succeeds → profile ready

name: Correct a missing target language before saving
outcome: Field error, retained level; corrected profile saved

name: Change unsaved choices from the privacy notice
path: Learner choice [Back] A3 → form → Finish setup → save
outcome: Changed unsaved selections used in one new profile

name: Retry a failed profile save
path: Save succeeded? [no] A5 → Try again → save [yes]
outcome: No false success; retry creates one profile

name: Leave setup after a failed profile save
outcome: No completed profile; prior data unchanged

name: Save a recording and its transcript locally
path: Ready [yes] → audio saved [yes] → transcript non-empty [yes] → transcript saved [yes]
outcome: One entry; local playback/transcript; no transmission

name: Explain denied microphone access
path: Ready to record? [no] → explain permission problem → not started

name: Report a failed audio save
outcome: Recoverable audio retained; retry offered; attempt incomplete

name: Keep saved audio when transcription finds no speech
path: Audio saved [yes] → Non-empty transcript? [no] → transcript pending
outcome: Saved audio retained; feedback unavailable; retry/leave offered

name: Report a failed transcript save
path: Audio saved [yes] → Non-empty transcript [yes] → Transcript saved? [no]
outcome: Saved audio retained; transcript-save retry offered

name: Save and display new language feedback
path: Saved feedback [no] → online [yes] → usable [yes] → local save [yes]
outcome: New feedback saved/displayed; profile updated once

name: Read saved feedback while offline
path: Saved feedback available? [yes] A1/R → display/read saved feedback
outcome: No network request or repeated profile update

name: Defer new feedback while offline
path: Saved feedback [no] → Online? [no] → offline message → deferred
outcome: No new request or available result

name: Reject an unusable feedback response
outcome: Failure message; no saved feedback/profile update

name: Accept valid feedback with empty suggestion lists
path: Usable response? [yes, empty lists valid] → save [yes] → display empty categories
outcome: Saved valid empty result; no invented corrections

name: Mark received feedback as unsaved after a storage failure
path: Usable response [yes] → Local save succeeded? [no] → unsaved result
outcome: Recoverable result; local retry offered; prior profile intact
